verses.text: Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ay juntzanh tastak tz'ik'an somchajel spensar heb' anima, palta a wal mach tz'ak'an somchajel spensar heb' yetanimail, te chuk yiko'.
Oktom b'ab'el spixjioch junok niwakil k'een t'a sjaj, syumjikanb'at t'a yol ha' mar yik sjik' ha' schami, yakb'an manto yak' somchaj spensar junok uninto. Tato icha chi', te wach' yiko'.
Yuj chi' tzeyil wal he b'a. Tato ay junok eyetanimail tz'och smul t'ayex, tzeyal t'ay. Tato sna sb'a, tzeyak' niwank'olal.

Wach'chom ukel tz'och smul t'ayex t'a junok k'u, palta ukel sb'at yalxi sb'a t'ayex syalan icha tik: Hak'in niwank'olal, manhxo ol in k'ulej junelxo, tato xchi, yowalil tzeyak' niwank'olal, xchi Jesús.
Ha heb' schekab' Jesús ix halan t'ay: --Ochanh ket'ok yik sko wach' ak'ejoch Dios t'a ko k'ool, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb': --Tato yel tzeyak'och Dios t'a he k'ool, wach'chom jab'nhej, icha kilan junok pitanh sat anh mostaza, ol yal eyalan t'a jun niwan te' tik: K'eanhkot yet' sch'anhal ib'. Tzach b'atkan t'a yol ha' mar. B'at awejempax a b'a ta', tato xe chi, ol sk'anab'ajej te' icha tzeyal chi'.

K'inalok ay junok ko chekab' tzonh ak'an serwil. Tato ayb'at t'a ko munlajel, mato ayb'at iloj kalnel, ma iloj wakax, haxo yik sjaxi, ¿tom naan kalan t'ay? Ochanh, emanh k'ojan, wa''anh, ¿tom xko chi t'ay?
Maay jun. Tekan icha tik skutej kalan t'ay: K'exel a b'a, b'ikel a k'ab'. Tza b'oan in wael, tzak'ankot t'ayin. Ichato chi' ol ach wa ach tik, xko chi t'ay.
¿Tom skak' yuj diosal t'ay yujnhej to ix sk'anab'ajej tas ix kal chi'? Maay.

Icha jun chekab' chi', ichex ta'. Ayik toxo ix lajwi he k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il Dios, smoj tzeyal icha tik: Te malaj wach' kochi, anhej juntzanh tas ix chekji ko k'ulej ix ko b'o'o, xe chi, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Haxo Jesús, hanheja' sb'at t'a sb'eal Jerusalén, ix k'och t'a smojonal Samaria yet' Galilea.
Ayik ix k'och t'a jun aldea, ay lajunhwanh heb' winh penaay yuj jun yab'il skuch lepra. Yuj chi' maj snitzochlaj sb'a heb' winh t'a stz'ey Jesús,
tonhej ix awajkot heb' winh t'ay: --Mamin Jesús, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayonh, xchikot heb' winh.
Haxo ix iljib'at heb' yuj Jesús, ix yalanb'at t'a heb': --Ixikek, ix ch'oxek he b'a t'a heb' sacerdote, xchi t'a heb' winh. Yakb'an wan sb'ey heb' winh, ipan sb'oxi heb' winh.
Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh chi', ayik ix yilan winh to toxo ix b'o sk'ool, ix meltzaj winh, ix och ijan winh yalan wach' lolonel t'a Dios, ix awaj wal chaanh winh.
Ix jawi winh t'a yichanh Jesús, ix em kumnaj winh t'a sat lu'um yik syak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay. Aj Samaria jun winh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús: --¿Tom manh lajunhwanhok heb' winh ix b'oxi sk'ool? ¿B'aj ay b'alunhwanhxo heb' winh chi'?
Ha jun winh tik, ch'ok chonhab'il winh, palta anhej winh ix ul halan wach' lolonel t'a Dios.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --K'eanh waan, paxanh. Ach b'oxi yujto in ak'och t'a a k'ool, xchi t'a winh.
Ay juntzanh heb' winh fariseo ix k'anb'an t'a Jesús: --¿B'ak'inh wal ol och Dios Kajalok? xchi heb' winh t'ay. --Ayik ol och Dios Kajalok, max yal-laj kilan yet' ko sat.
Max yal-laj kalani: Ayek' t'a tik, ma ayek' t'a chi', manh xko chiok, yujto ha t'a ko pixan tz'och Yajalil, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan t'a heb' sk'ayb'um: --Ay wal jun pekti' ol jawok, ol eyalan icha tik: Tzok wal jax junelxo jun Ak'b'ilkot yuj Dios t'a ko kal tik, wach'chom junnhejlaj k'ual, xe chama. Palta manhxo ol jalaj.
Ay heb' ol alanok: Ina yajek' t'a tik, ma ina yajek' t'a chi', xcham heb', palta manh ex b'atok, manh ex och tzak'an yuj heb'.
Yujto icha wal yek' kopnaj lheb'lon, sakb'i smasanil satcha'anh yuj, icha chi' ol aj in ja t'a jun k'ual a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik.
Palta yowalil ol in b'ab'laj ab'ej wal syail sik'lab'il. Ol in spatikejel heb' anima t'a jun pekti' tik.
Ayik ol in jaxok, lajan ol aj icha jun pekti' ayik yek'nak winhaj Noé.

Yujto a heb' anima t'a jun pekti' chi', ichnhejta' yek' k'u yuj heb': Swa heb', syuk'an ha' heb', ay heb' wan yoch yetb'eyum, ay heb' wan sk'anji yisil. Max snalaj heb' tato ay tas ol ja t'a yib'anh heb'. Icha chi' yek' tiempo yuj heb' masanto k'och sk'ual yoch winhaj Noé chi' t'a yol te' arka. Haton ta' kotnak jun niwan ha' mukwajum, laj cham heb' smasanil.
Icha pax chi', ujinak t'a stiempoal pax winhaj Lot: Swa heb', syuk'an ha' heb', smanwaj heb', schonhwaj heb', syawej tastak heb', slaj sb'oan spat heb'.
Ha wal yelkankot winhaj Lot t'a yol chonhab' Sodoma, yemul jun k'ak' yet' juntzanh kotak k'een chak xilinak. Icha wal yem nhab', icha chi' yemta t'a satcha'anh. Icha chi' aj scham heb' smasanil.
Icha wal ajnak t'a jun pekti' chi', icha chi' ol aj in ja a in tik, xchi Jesús.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', tato ay heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh spat, wach'chom ay tas aykan yuj heb' t'a yol spat, mokxob' emtalaj heb' yik'eli. Tato ay heb' ayb'at munlajel, mokxob' meltzaj heb' t'a spat.
Tze nakot tas ajnak ix yetb'eyum winhaj Lot chi'.
Ha heb' snib'ej skol sb'a t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol satel sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Haxo heb' syak'cham sb'a wuuj, ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Swal t'ayex, tato ay chawanhok waynak t'a sat sch'at t'a jun ak'wal chi', ay jun ol ik'jokb'atok, ay junxo ol kanok.
K'inalok ay chawanhok heb' ix wan smol cheni, jun ix ol ik'jokb'atok, haxo junxo ix ol kanok, xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'ay: --¿B'ajtil ol ujok jun chi' Mamin? xchi heb'. --Icha tz'ajk'och nok' ostok b'aj ay junok chamnak nok', icha chi' ol ajok, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
